verdict.rationale: Deel exposes payroll, contracts, and people data via REST API and an MCP server that lets AI agents pull this data (deel-docs-2, deel-docs-8, deel-docs-15, deel-docs-23), which supports the 'pull via API' half of the story. However, there is no evidence of a payroll journal/GL export format or reconciliation-into-ledger functionality—no mention of accounting journal entries, chart-of-accounts mapping, or ledger sync tools.
